subject: Signal routing certification & marketplace enablement
messages:
From: Claire Adams <claire.adams@datadoghq.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 9 May 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Signal routing certification & marketplace enablement

Hi Laura —

Great to reconnect. Datadog is keen to include Redwood in our Observability Marketplace and we want to make sure the signal-routing/cutover certification (OTLP -> broker -> Datadog ingest) is validated before go-live. To get the enablement and co-sell pipeline moving we need a few pieces from your side: a short mutual action plan, SOC2 excerpt for data handling, and a network diagram that shows egress paths and any proxy/broker layers.

Can you confirm who on your side owns:
- Technical certification (tests & acceptance)
- Security evidence (SOC2 / encryption / KMS)
- Marketplace listing content and co-selling ops

We can share a template MAP and a suggested acceptance checklist. I attached a sample to speed things up. Also proposing a 30 min sync early next week to align timelines.

Thanks —
Claire Adams
Partnerships, Datadog
claire.adams@datadoghq.com

Attachment: DATADOG-MAP-sample.xlsx (attachment stub)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 9 May 2028 14:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Signal routing certification & marketplace enablement

Claire —

Appreciate the note and the template. Quick answers:
- Technical certification owner: Ben Carter (cc'd) — he will coordinate test plans and a smoke-run on our staging broker.
- Security evidence owner: Neha Kapoor (cc'd) — she'll provide SOC2 excerpts and network control descriptions.
- Marketplace listing/content & GTM ops: me — I'll coordinate marketing assets and the co-sell intake form.

I'm attaching our mutual_action_plan.xlsx with a proposed timeline (pilot window: Jun 5 - Jun 19). Next steps I propose:
1) Ben to share a short acceptance test matrix by Tue (May 14).
2) Neha to provide SOC2 excerpts + any redactions by Wed (May 15).
3) 30-min sync to pair on test harness and listing copy — Wed May 16 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET?

Can you confirm the time or propose alternate slots? Also, please send the Datadog contact for marketplace ops (if different from you).

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Head, Business Partnerships
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx (attachment stub)

Ack — adding the integration engineering team to the May 16 call.

Quick note on the acceptance matrix we plan to deliver:
- Ingest latency under 150ms P50 for a 2k token payload (staging traffic pattern).
- No dropped spans for TLS-offloaded flows.
- Header preservation (x-request-id, x-trace-id) across broker hops.
- End-to-end sample payload and minimal load test script attached to the MAP in Drive.

I'll have the detailed matrix in the shared MAP by EOD Tue May 14.

-Ben

Laura / Ben —

I reviewed the SOC2 excerpt from Claire. It covers the control families we need to present for marketplace listing. Two asks from security to complete the package:
1) A short runbook (1 page) describing encryption at rest and key rotation cadence for customer keys in Redwood Private/Dedicated — I'll draft and circulate by Wed May 15.
2) A statement of data retention for logs/ingest: confirm default 30 days and optional retention tiers.

Once those are in the MAP we can mark security evidence as satisfied and request marketplace ops to start content verification.

Neha Kapoor

Redwood Inference
